title: JPMorgan’s US$8b EA Buyout Deal And What It Means For Valuation
title_zh: 摩根大通 8 亿美元收购 EA 交易及其对估值的影响
summary: JPMorgan Chase (NYSE:JPM) is leading a consortium of banks in launching an $8b junk bond sale. The debt issuance is intended to finance the leveraged buyout of video game publisher Electronic Arts.
summary_zh: 摩根大通（纽约证券交易所股票代码：JPM）正在牵头一个银行财团发起 80 亿美元的垃圾债券销售。此次债券发行旨在为视频游戏发行商艺电公司的杠杆收购提供资金。

title: Adeia CEO Highlights Patent Growth, OTT Deals and “Seminal” AMD License at Roth Conference
title_zh: Adeia 首席执行官在 Roth 会议上强调专利增长、OTT 交易和“开创性”AMD 许可
summary: Adeia (NASDAQ:ADEA) CEO Paul Davis outlined the company’s evolution since its separation from Xperi in October 2022, highlighting a strategy centered on research and development, patent licensing, and what he described as an expanding opportunity set across both media and semi...
summary_zh: Adeia（纳斯达克股票代码：ADEA）首席执行官 Paul Davis 概述了该公司自 2022 年 10 月从 Xperi 分离以来的演变，强调了以研发、专利许可为中心的战略，以及他所描述的跨媒体和半领域不断扩大的机会集。

title: Ecolab Nears Deal for KKR’s Data-Center Cooling Company
title_zh: 艺康 (Ecolab) 即将收购 KKR 数据中心冷却公司
summary: Ecolab  is nearing a deal to acquire data-center cooling company CoolIT Systems from  KKR  for between $4.5 billion and $5 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.
summary_zh: 据知情人士透露，Ecolab 即将达成协议，以 45 亿至 50 亿美元的价格从 KKR 手中收购数据中心冷却公司 CoolIT Systems。
